scope:
Package K1c-3a (KERNEL ONLY, small): finish what K1c-2 left, so the web can open the receipt in the graph NAVIGATOR (the same call the rest of the app uses to 'show in graph'). Branch claude/m1-w0 is at 568afce9 (= K1c-2 + origin/main efb31fcf; the local gate k1c2 is running until ~08:25 - you start AFTER it, the tree is clean). Read first: docs/reports/INDEX.md section 'S1 / M1-K1c2' (decisions, how to reverse) and the K1c-2 card facts below; nothing else of the docs.
FACTS from K1c-2 (checked by its agent): the perspective 'sent_to_model' (loom/data/runtime/graph_views.pack, source 'receipt', relations sent_to_model + left_out_of_model) is rendered by loom_perspectives / the action perspectives.show {id:'sent_to_model', msg_id | seeds[0] | focus (request id, answer id or address 'msg:<id>'), label_chars, lang}: implementation loom/src/graph/projection_receipt.cpp (projection::render_receipt, declared in loom/include/loom/ or src graph/projection.h), the 'receipt' branch in loom/src/views/perspectives.cpp, the shared reader chat::formats::stored_receipt (src/chat/context_format.cpp). Derived (not stored) nodes have ids sent:<request_msg_id>:<ref>; real elements are msg:<id> / memory:<id> addresses. Nothing is written to nodes/links (a projection). Three GAPS remain, all kernel: (1) graph.navigate (loom/src/graph/projection.cpp, perspective branch ~lines 2549-2606) with perspectives=['sent_to_model'] and a msg:<id> focus only reads catalogue edges, so it returns NOTHING for this perspective. Fix: for a perspective whose source is 'receipt', call render_receipt for the focus and append its edges (and the node rows) to the navigate answer, in the SAME row shape navigate already returns for catalogue nodes (read how 'all' edges and node rows are built there); the derived sent: nodes need catalogue-shaped rows because Catalogue::node() does not know them (build them from the render data: id, kind, label, derived:true, the section/why/tokens in metadata). The 1-hop neighbourhood of the focus message must show the sent elements with the link weight = tokens; left_out_of_model links must be visible too. (2) graph.card (the card of one node) does not know the sent:<req>:<ref> addresses: it must answer for a derived sent: node from the stored receipt (label, kind, class/section, why, tokens_est, 'derived': true, and in words that this node is a view of the record, not a stored node), never NotFound for an address the same navigate answer returned. (3) the action catalogue entry perspectives.show (loom/data/runtime/actions.pack ~line 11883) does not declare the params msg_id and label_chars although the op reads them: declare them (types, descriptions pl+en as the neighbours do) and regenerate the runtime profiles (python3 loom/src/model/gen_runtime_profiles.py, then --check). If the registry pins in data_domains.pack need re-pinning (sha256 of a changed pack the way the neighbours are pinned) do it and run ctest -R 'graph_entry|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|runtime_profile|onboarding_pack|graph_proj'. TESTS: extend loom/tests/test_graph_sent_to_model.cpp (or the navigate test next to it) with a synthetic conversation sent through a mock model: navigate(focus msg:<request>, perspectives ['sent_to_model']) returns the request node plus the sent elements and the weights, a left_out link for a dropped group, the derived rows; card(address of a derived node) answers; the row counts of nodes/links in the database are equal before and after (nothing written); a message without a record answers the same empty/missing_reason as perspectives.show (not an error). DECISIONS ARE YOURS (R1-R53, nothing hidden silently, words are data pl+en); record them with how to reverse under 'S1 / M1-K1c3a' in docs/reports/INDEX.md. Do NOT touch loom/web (next package K1c-3b), loom/android/smoke/*, the golden chat_request_legacy.json, or the receipt schema. If a web API route literal is added or changed (it should not be: graph.navigate / graph.card exist), run the registry chain (gen_graph_interfaces.py -> gen_runtime_profiles.py -> re-pin sha256 of graph/interfaces.pack in data_domains.pack -> the ctest set above). Commit in 2-3 pieces and push to origin claude/m1-w0. If after about 50 tool calls a piece is unfinished, commit what is consistent and return done=false with exactly what is left.
accept: cmake --build --preset dev (background, polled with short calls) succeeds; ctest --preset dev -R 'context_receipt|context_modify|graph_|perspective|views|navigate|runtime_profile|onboarding_pack|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|abi_compat|compat' green; python3 tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev (the tool lives in /home/user/chatadhd/tools/ - run it from there against this build dir) all ok; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/lint_asan_range_for.py 568afce9 shows 0 suspicious lines; pushed to origin claude/m1-w0. The card pastes: the navigate answer for a synthetic request (node and edge counts, one sent element row, one left_out row, one derived row), the card answer of a derived node, the unchanged db row counts, the decisions with how to reverse them, and exactly what is left.
rules_extra: Shared machine: never kill processes by name; record the pid/port you started. Do NOT run the full gate (S1 does). CACHE RULE: no single tool call longer than ~4 minutes - run builds and tests in the background and poll with short calls. One native build at a time (disk is small: use loom/build/dev of this worktree, no second build tree). Keep context small: grep and line ranges, never dump big files. ASAN pitfall: never range-for over .at()/.value()/operator[] of a by-value temporary - bind to a named const first. Generated *.inc data keeps explicit lengths (the generators already do). Tests must not depend on speed or order. Private data: synthetic data only; never read docs/exports or eval/real-holdout-key. Texts for the owner in plain Polish and English; nothing described as working that is only planned.
